subject.title: fix(google-vertex): add Google Vertex AI onboarding wizard, fix ADC auth, add provider docs

question: Should OpenClaw ship an ADC-first Google Vertex onboarding flow that writes GCP project/location configuration and records an ambient-auth marker, while keeping any Vertex API-key path outside the wizard unless separately designed?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent and has live GCE proof, but it creates a durable provider onboarding/auth contract whose supported credential modes and upgrade behavior are product decisions rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Sponsor ADC-first onboarding
options.body: Merge only after confirming ADC as the supported wizard path, documenting the API-key boundary, and adding focused fresh-install plus rerun/upgrade regression coverage.

options.title: Keep Vertex setup manual
options.body: Do not add the wizard path now; retain the existing documented ADC configuration while a broader provider-auth direction is decided.

recommendation.title: Sponsor ADC-first onboarding
recommendation.body: Merge only after confirming ADC as the supported wizard path, documenting the API-key boundary, and adding focused fresh-install plus rerun/upgrade regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent shipped Google Vertex ADC work makes this contributor the strongest evidence-backed routing candidate for the provider contract decision.
